summary: Today we are shipping intelligent routing for local models into experimental preview. GitHub Copilot Fusion can now choose between supported on-device models and cloud models, enabling intelligent local model routing in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code.
takeaways: For setup instructions, see Adding LLM models to GitHub Copilot CLI and Adding LLM models to the GitHub Copilot app .
GitHub Copilot Fusion can now choose between supported on-device models and cloud models, enabling intelligent local model routing in GitHub Copilot CLI, GitHub Copilot app, and Visual Studio Code.
In Copilot CLI , enable experimental mode and open /model to follow the setup prompts.
